# Smart Glasses Technical Terminology \- Chinese/English Reference

*Comprehensive bilingual terminology for smart glasses development and Chinese manufacturing*

| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

| Resolution | 分辨率 | fēn biàn lǜ | H × V pixels |

| Optical coating | 光学镀膜 | guāng xué dù mó | Surface treatment |
| Lens grinding | 镜片研磨 | jìng piàn yán mó | Precision manufacturing |

| Waveguide fabrication | 波导制造 | bō dǎo zhì zào | AR display manufacturing |
| Interferometer | 干涉仪 | gān shè yí | Optical testing |
| Calibration standards | 校准标准 | jiào zhǔn biāo zhǔn | Quality verification |
